name: India Brown
bio: India Brown is a British actress who is best known for her role as Jamila Huston in the sci-fi series Invasion (2021). She began her career as a model when she was still a baby and later played Young Nala in the musical The Lion King in London's West End.

credits.title: Drummer Boy
credits.overview: As America’s fight for independence begins, a young drummer boy, an enslaved woman, and a divided family search for freedom. Through battle and loss, music carries hope in a deeply human story of faith and forgiveness.

credits.title: That Christmas
credits.overview: It's an unforgettable Christmas for the townsfolk of Wellington-on-Sea when the worst snowstorm in history alters everyone's plans — including Santa's.

credits.title: The Midnight Gang
credits.overview: When Tom gets hit on the head by a cricket ball, he finds himself on the miserable children's ward of St Hugo's Hospital, where he is greeted by a terrifying-looking porter and wicked matron. But things aren't as bad as they seem and Tom is soon to embark on the most thrilling journey of a lifetime!
